Q003.locator: Magic Items: Activating an Item; Combat: Two-Weapon Fighting; Rage; Misty Step
Q003.audit_note: Clarified 2014 action economy; healing potions use an action.

Q004.audit_note: Ends at the end of the monk's next turn, not a fixed duration measured from the hit.

Q005.audit_note: Automatic Strength and Dexterity saving-throw failures.

Q006.audit_note: Three simultaneous items, not a daily limit.

Q007.audit_note: Three darts plus one per slot level above first gives five, not six.

Q008.audit_note: Half cover grants +2 AC and Dexterity saves.

Q009.audit_note: AC 17; distinguished monster, magic item, and animated-object spell statistics.

Q010.audit_note: Replaced a multiple-correct-answer stem with the fighter's unique four-attack progression.

Q011.audit_note: A third-level casting automatically counters spells of third level or lower, assuming a legal target.

Q012.locator: Combat: Squeezing into a Smaller Space (p. 92)
Q012.audit_note: Included all squeezing penalties, not an incomplete speed-halving shorthand.

Q015.audit_note: Base Rage resists all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, but not fire; excluded subclass exceptions.

Q016.audit_note: Old question also had V and S as correct answers. All new choices are material components; the priced diamond is required.

Q017.audit_note: A short rest lasts at least one hour.

Q018.locator: Personality and Background: Inspiration, Using Inspiration
Q018.audit_note: Specified eligible rolls and the 2014 advantage mechanic.

Q020.audit_note: Official legacy summary confirms medium armor and shields; do not use the revised 2024 feat.

Q021.audit_note: Damage calls for a Constitution saving throw, not an ability check.

Q022.audit_note: 10 plus the full Perception modifier; excluded advantage and other modifiers.

Q023.audit_note: A roll of 10 or higher succeeds.

Q024.audit_note: A level-3 sorcerer knows four cantrips.

Q025.audit_note: Specified wizard class levels to avoid fighter, rogue, and multiclass exceptions.

Q028.audit_note: Specified running start and movement budget; distance is Strength score in feet.

Q029.audit_note: Poison immunity prevents poison damage absent an explicit exception.

Q030.audit_note: +5 AC for the spell's duration, including the triggering attack.

Q031.audit_note: Double the attack's damage dice, not modifiers or the entire rolled total.

Q032.audit_note: Loading applies per firing action, bonus action, or reaction, not once per whole turn.

Q033.audit_note: Pact Magic slots are fifth level; Mystic Arcanum is a separate feature.

Q034.audit_note: Replaced an undefined corridor/splash-grid question with the total-cover rule.

Q036.audit_note: Releasing the readied shot uses a reaction when the trigger finishes.

Q038.audit_note: Bonus applies to attack and damage rolls.

Q039.audit_note: Spell creates up to ten, not necessarily exactly ten; question now asks the maximum.

Q040.audit_note: Ten minutes of concentration makes the wall permanent, not one minute.

Q041.locator: Faerie Fire; Conditions: Prone; Advantage and Disadvantage
Q041.audit_note: Specified sight and 30-foot range; ranged attacks within 5 feet are not inherently disadvantaged by prone.

Q042.audit_note: Normal casting takes one minute; a ritual would take eleven minutes.

Q044.audit_note: Restrained sets speed to zero; it does not halve speed.

Q045.audit_note: Flight becomes available at druid level 8; key must contain option D, not numeral 8.

Q046.audit_note: Alchemist's supplies cost 50 gp, not 30 gp.

Q047.audit_note: Walking speed is 25 feet and heavy armor does not reduce it.

Q049.audit_note: Restriction applies only to the same turn and allows one-action cantrips.

Q050.audit_note: 10 plus Dexterity and Constitution modifiers; shield remains allowed.

Q051.audit_note: Hit Die is d8 per cleric level.

Q052.audit_note: Strength 13 AND Charisma 13, not either score.

Q053.audit_note: Greatsword deals 2d6; changed singular die to dice.

Q054.audit_note: Range is 150 feet, distinct from area radius.

Q055.audit_note: 6500 total XP; moving from the level-4 minimum of 2700 requires 3800 more. Removed total/increment ambiguity.

Q056.audit_note: Can spend any or all remaining Hit Dice.

Q058.audit_note: One artisan-tool proficiency. Primary full text not accessible in this audit; retained provisionally.

Q059.audit_note: At level 10 the die becomes d10.

Q060.audit_note: A small taste identifies the potion; removed invented DC 15 Arcana rule.

Q063.locator: Wizard: Your Spellbook, Copying a Spell into the Book
Q063.audit_note: 50 gp per spell level; distinguished copying a new spell from replacing one's own book and excluded discounts.

Q064.audit_note: Highest individual CR is 2; upcasting increases numbers, not the maximum CR.

Q065.audit_note: Listed average is 17 HP (5d6); clarified monster rather than Animate Objects.

Q067.audit_note: Corrected feat name and separated its +10-foot speed benefit from its Dash/difficult-terrain benefit. Full text needs verification.

Q068.locator: Between Adventures: Crafting a Magic Item (pp. 128-129)
Q068.audit_note: 100 gp divided by 25 gp/day is four days; old 100-day answer was wrong. Arithmetic is clear, but the 2014 option's source needs verification.

Q069.audit_note: Provisional correction to third-level maximum at fighter 14; fourth-level slots arrive at 19. No new slot level is gained at 14.

Q070.audit_note: One attunement if required; artifact rarity alone does not establish an attunement requirement.

Q071.audit_note: Glaive adds five feet to normal reach for its attacks; specified normal reach of five feet.

Q072.audit_note: Adds d4 to one ability check under the spell's conditions.

Q073.audit_note: Replaced an undefined underwater long-jump trick question with explicit swimming movement cost.

Q074.audit_note: 1d10 plus fighter level, not Constitution modifier.

Q075.audit_note: Six levels cause death in the 2014 rules.
